{{Top|leg}}
'''Master of the Sword''' was an accolade bestowed upon [[Kentra]] who were considered to be a master in the one of the [[Species/Legends|species']] three disciplines; [[Sword, Plow, and Spirit]]. [[King/Legends|King]] [[Jerius]] was a Master of the Sword.<ref name="TP">{{JournalCite|2|The Prophecy}}</ref>
